blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense counsel and spokesperson Michael Poa said on Monday that it was too early to discuss whether the defense would call Vice President Sara Duterte to testify in her impeachment trial. He made the statement before the defense team began presenting its evidence-in-chief on the 40th day of Duterte’s trial, when asked whether the vice president would finally face the Senate impeachment court. “It’s still too early to talk about that. It’s just the first day of our presentation,” Poa told reporters in an interview at the Senate. WATCH: With 30 trial days allotted for the defense, Atty. […]...
